items.title: Where Do I Start?

items.description: Core repositories and resources maintained by Nous Research.

items.title: Hermes Agent
items.description: by Nous Research - The core project. Self-improving agent with a closed learning loop, skill creation and curation, persistent memory, 20+ messaging platforms, six terminal backends (local, Docker, SSH, Singularity, Modal, and Daytona), cron scheduling, MCP integration, isolated profiles, provider routing, and automatic migration from OpenClaw. 215k+ stars.

items.title: Release Notes
items.description: Official changelog with feature highlights, migration notes, and reliability fixes for each Hermes version.

items.title: hermes-agent-self-evolution
items.description: by Nous Research - Evolutionary self-improvement using DSPy and GEPA (Genetic Evolution of Prompt Architectures). The research pipeline for optimizing Hermes's own prompts and behaviors.

items.title: hermes-paperclip-adapter
items.description: by Nous Research - Run Hermes as a managed employee in Paperclip companies. Connects the agent to Paperclip's task management and governance system.

items.title: autonovel
items.description: by Nous Research - Autonomous novel-writing pipeline built on Hermes. Generates long-form manuscripts (100k+ words) end-to-end using the agent loop.

items.title: tinker-atropos
items.description: by Nous Research - Standalone Atropos integration with Thinking Machines Tinker API. RL training infrastructure for fine-tuning tool-calling models on real agent trajectories.

items.title: Official Resources

items.description: Skills are procedural memory — reusable capabilities that Hermes creates from experience and improves during use. Plugins extend core functionality.

children.title: [beta] OMH (oh-my-hermes by rlaope)
children.description: by rlaope - Wrapper orchestration layer installed next to Hermes — one installs 80+ generated workflow skills plus a deterministic chat router that turns free-form Korean/English chat into the right prepared workflow, clarifying instead of guessing when confidence is low. Coding work is delegated to an explicitly selected executor (Codex, Claude Code, or the Hermes runtime) with a strict prepared-vs-observed evidence boundary. A 156-case bilingual routing corpus and ~1,500 unit tests gate every change in CI. Pure Python, zero runtime dependencies, never patches Hermes; docs in four languages. Distinct project from witt3rd's oh-my-hermes above. MIT.

children.title: [beta] LinkedIn Skills
children.description: by Serge Bulaev - Ten portable skills for drafting, reviewing, and planning LinkedIn content. MIT licensed and compatible with agentskills.io hosts, including Hermes.

children.title: [beta] hermes-skill-factory
children.description: by Romanescu11 - Meta-skill that auto-generates reusable skills from your workflows. Point it at a task you repeat and it creates a skill for it.

children.title: [beta] hermes-plugins
children.description: by 42-evey - Plugin suite: Discord voice bridge with Gemini Live, WhatsApp bridge, goal management, inter-agent bridge, model selection, and cost control. Maintained by a frequent Hermes core contributor.

children.title: [experimental] super-hermes
children.description: by Cranot - Teaches Hermes to write its own analytical prompts. Adds a meta-reasoning layer where the agent generates better prompts for itself before executing tasks.

children.title: [beta] emulo
children.description: by ohad6k - Mines local Claude Code, Codex, and Copilot session logs into a portable user profile that Hermes can load as a skill. Runs locally and is MIT licensed.

children.title: [beta] oh-my-hermes
children.description: by witt3rd - Multi-agent orchestration skills for Hermes inspired by and rebuilt on Hermes primitives. Suite covers deep-research, deep-interview, (Planner → Architect → Critic consensus), (verified execute → verify → iterate), , and , plus driver skills encoding the dispatcher's playbook. Composes end-to-end: research → interview → consensus plan → verified execution.

children.title: [beta] litprog-skill
children.description: by tlehman - Literate programming skill that works across Claude Code, OpenCode, and Hermes. Weaves code and prose into documented, executable notebooks.

children.title: [experimental] humanizer-ru
children.description: by ilyautov - Removes AI-writing tells from Russian text (bureaucratese, calques, ChatGPT/Claude fingerprints). 52 patterns, deterministic offline scanner. SKILL.md-compatible. MIT.

children.title: [experimental] hermes-life-os
children.description: by Lethe044 - Personal OS agent that detects daily patterns and learns your routines over time. Uses Hermes's memory system for lifestyle tracking, not just code.

children.title: [beta] hermes-dojo
children.description: by Yonkoo11 - Self-improvement system that monitors agent performance, identifies weak skills, and iterates on them automatically.

children.title: [experimental] Wizards-of-the-Ghosts

children.title: [experimental] personal-api
children.description: by beiyuii - Turn your Obsidian vault into an identity layer any AI agent can read in under 30 seconds

children.title: [beta] hermes-incident-commander
children.description: by Lethe044 - Autonomous SRE agent for production incident detection and self-healing. Monitors services, diagnoses failures, and applies fixes. Works well with Hermes's cron scheduling.

children.title: [experimental] hermes-skill-marketplace
children.description: by Lethe044 - Agent that writes, tests, and publishes new skills autonomously. Automates the skill creation and distribution lifecycle.

children.title: [beta] hermes-nextcloud
children.description: by adnw-vinc - Self-hosted Nextcloud bridge — manage files (WebDAV), notes (Nextcloud Notes API), calendar/tasks (CalDAV), and contacts (CardDAV) from Hermes. children.title: [beta] PolyBrain
children.description: by mosesman831 - Multi-agent, multi-model orchestration skill that decomposes an objective into a JSON task plan, runs research and build subtasks in parallel, then synthesizes and verifies a final answer. Each role can use a different LLM/provider. Enforces strict citations and drops uncited claims.

children.title: [beta] hurmoz
children.description: by Moshe-ship - Arabic-first skills pack — 63 skills across Islamic tools (prayer times, zakat, Quran), dialect-aware NLP, content, and travel. Install: .

children.title: [beta] hermes-spotify-skill
children.description: by Alexeyisme - Spotify playback control for headless Linux and Raspberry Pi 4/5. Search, play, pause, skip, set volume, transfer between Spotify Connect devices. No daemon — Hermes writes spotipy snippets and runs them via . Works with raspotify for Pi-as-speaker. Tested on Raspberry Pi OS Lite Bookworm 64-bit. The only Linux-native Spotify skill in the ecosystem.

children.title: [experimental] tech-debt-management-skill
children.description: by Vincent-crypto-coder - Systematic technical debt management for Python projects. Automates scanning (pylint, radon, safety, bandit, flake8), prioritizes debt with a 4-dimension matrix, and generates executable refactoring plans with verification scripts.

children.title: [beta] hermes-skills
children.description: by RobinBeraud - Growing skills library covering finance (FMP stock/crypto data), web (Firecrawl scrape/search), WhatsApp (WBizTool contacts), and marketing/SEO. Each skill follows standard SKILL.md format.

children.title: [beta] twitr-skills

Pay-per-call in USDC (x402 on Base/Solana, MPP on Tempo) — no API key or signup; treat publish/presence skills as high-privilege. MIT.

children.title: [beta] blacktea
children.description: by nmrtn - Spending controls for agents that pay online via x402. Holds over-limit payments for human approval in the chat, enforces a JSON policy, and audits every spend. Ships as an MCP server (pay, approve_payment, reject_payment, audit_query) plus an SDK and CLI.

children.title: [beta] pingpong
children.description: by 0xAaronx0 - Spontaneous local leisure meetups: agent posts a pseudonymous, coarse-geo offer to a shared board; nearby agents match locally and negotiate place/time with double-opt-in before contact.

children.title: [beta] hermes-telegram-checklist
children.description: by johnsje183 - Native Telegram To-Do lists (real interactive checkboxes with a progress counter) in chats and forum topics — create, read, append, toggle with a write allowlist and offline plan validation. Uses a Telethon user session (MTProto) because the Bot API can't post checklists into groups; treat the session account accordingly. MIT, CI across Python 3.9–3.13.

children.title: [experimental] obsidian-auto-context
children.description: by SkillForge Labs - Captures each session's findings, decisions, and action items into an Obsidian vault as tagged, wiki-linked Markdown with daily-note rollups. Secrets are redacted before anything touches disk. MIT.

children.title: [beta] hermes-skill-kit
children.description: by duruonanni - Three community-vetted skills: feishu-document-api (programmatic Feishu/Lark document creation), feishu-response-format (Feishu response formatting with 3 table schemes, Card JSON 2.0, Markdown compatibility, 53 tests), and hermes-memory-maintenance (MEMORY.md/USER.md audit and drift recovery). Codex-audited.

children.title: [beta] hermes-tour-assistant
children.description: by MaikD77 - Three-in-one outdoor skill suite: Outdoor Tour Assistant (GPX route monitoring with weather, deviation alerts, and silent-by-default cron), City Walk Guide (personal OSM/Wikipedia walking tour with source-backed stories and optional voice), and Live Location Nearby (water, food, repair, and shelter via OSM/Overpass). MIT, Python 3.11+, 85%+ test coverage.

children.title: [experimental] loremaster
children.description: by loremaster-ai - AI scrum-master and PM skill pack extracted from a production multi-project deployment. Sprint ceremonies with planning poker, backlog proposals with verifiable done criteria, plan-conflict detection, and a per-project wiki vault with a knowledge graph. Every external write (Jira, wiki commits) goes through per-item human approval. MIT.

children.title: [beta] hermes-skills (liuyunnb666)
children.description: by liuyunnb666 - Seven curated skills for Hermes: debugging, parallel dev, TDD, and UI workflows.

children.title: [experimental] nika-agents
children.description: by SuperNovae Studio - Delegates repeatable work from Hermes to Nika workflows with static checks, cost caps, permits, and hash-chained execution traces. The integration skill is MIT; the Nika repository is AGPL-3.0.

children.title: [experimental] url-manager
children.description: by Piccolo123 - Agent-first URL collection and knowledge management: agents save, categorize, tag, search, and share web links, with collaborative shared categories and magic-link delivery back to the user. MIT client fronting a hosted backend (ai.ocean94.com) — an account is auto-created on first use and collected links are stored there; SKILL.md requires informing the user before first use.

children.title: [production] hermes-skills (winterliu6)
children.description: by winterliu6 - Chinese-focused skills pack: content-studio (小红书/抖音/公众号), security-newsletter (weekly cybersecurity awareness emails), and tech-ops-bot (企业微信/飞书 IT ops with fault classification and web dashboard). Production use at Yaolai Cinema IT.

children.description: by tsol - Starts Vite projects, a Hinge editing overlay, Cloudflare tunnels, and Telegram control for phone-based development with Hermes. Early project; review the install script before running it.

children.title: [experimental] skill-evolution
children.description: by okdk7788 - GEPA-style measured evolution for learned agent skills, adapted from Hermes self-improvement ideas for Claude Code. MIT licensed, but still at its initial public revision.

children.title: [experimental] code-assembly-skill
children.description: by baoyu0 - Search-first software assembly method for finding and composing existing tools before writing new code. Portable across Hermes, Claude Code, and Codex.

children.title: [experimental] hermes-do-task-skill
children.description: by baoyu0 - One-command workflow that plans a task, delegates execution, verifies the result, and writes a handoff. Early project with no published release.

children.title: [beta] policy-search-china-skill
children.description: by dongwei6688 - Search Chinese government policy documents across 16 ministries and extract verbatim citations with source links for reports and planning. Ships a large local policy cache plus scripted search chains; dual-space layout keeps user data separate from system updates. MIT.

children.title: [experimental] hermes-backup-recovery
children.description: by JimmyHuang2002 - Keeps a long-running Hermes recoverable: age-encrypted backups of everything under (memory, skills, config, chat history) with verification, restore drills, and a health check. Four short bash scripts plus a SKILL.md — no lock-in, archives are plain . MIT.

children.title: [beta] roadmap-tutor
children.description: by instax-dutta - Turns any of the 91 official roadmap.sh roadmaps into a resumable, one-topic-at-a-time curriculum with progress tracking across sessions. Topology-sorted learning path from reactflow graphs, stdlib-only Python, runs on Raspberry Pi 4 with 2GB RAM. Commands: start, next, done, skip, status, outline, search, goto, switch, prefetch, reset. Weekly CI verifies lossless parse across all 91 live roadmaps. MIT.

children.title: [experimental] hermes-startup
children.description: by 33hodl - First-dollar onboarding skill: walks a new operator from a working Hermes install to one genuine paid outcome, rather than to a demo.

children.title: [experimental] routerbase-agent-skills

Skill is MIT; deployments require an app.nz account and may consume paid credits.

children.title: [beta] shopify-app-review-brief

children.title: [production] open-design

Auto-detects 15 coding-agent CLIs from PATH and integrates with Hermes via ACP/JSON-RPC. BYOK proxy, sandboxed previews, can import Claude Design exports. 78k+ stars.

children.title: [production] Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills
children.description: by mukul975 - 753+ structured cybersecurity skills mapped to MITRE ATT&CK. 25k+ stars.

children.title: [production] drawio-skill
children.description: by Agents365-ai - Generates draw.io diagrams from natural language and exports to PNG/SVG/PDF. SKILL.md format, works across Claude Code, OpenClaw, Hermes, Codex. Useful when an agent needs to communicate architecture or process visually without a separate design step. 5.8k+ stars.

children.title: [production] wondelai/skills
children.description: by wondelai - Cross-platform agent skills for Claude Code and agentskills.io-compatible platforms.

children.title: [production] youtube-skills
children.description: by therohitdas - Adds YouTube search, channel browsing, playlist extraction, and reliable transcripts on top of Hermes's built-in . Built-in transcript fetch silently fails on VPS because YouTube blocks cloud IP ranges; this routes through TranscriptAPI's backend (15M+ transcripts/month) to stay unblocked. 12 sub-skills covering search → fetch → bulk extraction. Auto-invokes for creator lookups, topic research, and tutorials. The fix for "my Hermes can't watch YouTube on a $5 VPS."

children.title: [production] pydantic-ai-skills
children.description: by DougTrajano - Pydantic AI with agentskills.io support. Adds type-safe schema validation to agent skill inputs and outputs.

children.title: [beta] maestro
children.description: by ReinaMacCredy - Skill orchestration with Conductor planning and Beads tracking. Structures multi-step skill execution into observable pipelines.

children.title: [beta] x-twitter-scraper
children.description: by Xquik-dev - Typed X (Twitter) access via 43 narrow SKILL.md folders covering reads (search, timelines, mentions, trends, articles, bookmarks, for-you), writes (post, DM, follow, profile updates), bulk extraction (followers, communities, lists, spaces), AI composition (write-tweets, write-threads, optimize, going-viral), giveaways, monitors, and webhooks. No browser automation, no scraping — typed JSON in/out through the Xquik API. Fills the X gap for Hermes social workflows.

children.title: [beta] tiny.place
children.description: by TinyHumans - Agent-to-agent social network shipped as a portable skill: claim an @handle identity, get discovered in an open directory, message peers over Signal-protocol end-to-end encryption, and transact in USDC/SOL via x402. One SKILL.md runs on Hermes, OpenClaw, and any agentskills.io-compatible harness. GPL-3.0.

children.description: by Chainlink - Official Chainlink agent skills on the agentskills.io spec. Oracle network data, CCIP, and smart contract interaction.

children.title: [production] dev-gtm-claude-skills
children.description: by Infrasity-Labs - Cross-platform agent skills for SEO, GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), AI discoverability, and developer marketing.

children.title: [production] black-forest-labs/skills
children.description: by Black Forest Labs - Official FLUX model skills for image generation. First-party skills from the FLUX creators.

children.title: [beta] bmad-module-skill-forge
children.description: by armelhbobdad - Transforms repos and docs into agentskills.io-compliant skills. Input a codebase, output installable skills.

Log in once via browser PKCE or device code, credentials live in a local encrypted vault, and a local proxy injects them at request time so raw keys never enter the agent's environment. 45 providers preconfigured (14 OAuth2, 31 API credentials) including GitHub, Google, OpenAI, Linear, Slack, Notion, Resend, and Stripe. Skill installs into Hermes with . MIT.

children.title: [beta] plasma-wiki

Keeps project knowledge in Git-tracked plain Markdown with deterministic index maintenance, no hosted memory service or vector DB required. Apache-2.0.

children.description: by tiann - Manages complex, long-running task execution with proper lifecycle handling — progress tracking, checkpoints, and failure recovery.

children.title: [production] longbridge

children.title: [beta] Agentic-MCP-Skill
children.description: by cablate - MCP client with agentskills.io validation. Bridges MCP tool servers with the skills standard.

children.title: [production] abvx-agent-skills
children.description: by markoblogo - Auditable cross-platform coding-agent skillpack for smaller diffs, evidence-led debugging, token control, browser verification, and reviewable workflows with static security audit.

children.title: [beta] skillsdotnet

children.title: [beta] colony-skill
children.description: by TheColonyCC - Collaborative intelligence platform where AI agents and humans post findings, discuss ideas, complete tasks, earn karma, and build reputation. Community hub at thecolony.cc.

children.title: [production] outreachmagic
children.description: by Outreach Magic - GTM pipeline agent that syncs Smartlead, Instantly, HeyReach, PlusVibe, EmailBison, Prosp, and Calendly into a local SQLite database your agent can query.

children.title: [beta] invinoveritas
children.description: by babyblueviper1 - Portable agentskills.io skill + MCP recipe for pay-per-call tools over Bitcoin Lightning / USDC (x402). Governance gate before irreversible actions, markets intelligence, sandboxed code execution, and agent-to-agent payments.

children.title: [production] remoet
children.description: by remoet-labs - Job-search and career-discovery skill. Searches tech companies by actual tech stack, stars shortlisted companies, pulls jobs from that curated list, and reads/writes the developer profile. Backed by remote MCP with free tier.

children.title: [beta] arelay-skills
children.description: by mmmikael - Deliver reports, Markdown, HTML, images, and PDFs via Agent Relay with optional end-to-end encryption. Works with hosted or self-hosted instances. MIT.

children.title: [beta] zooidfund
children.description: by Ales375 - Lets an agent discover, evaluate, and donate USDC on Base to humanitarian crowdfunding campaigns at zooid.fund. Public campaign browsing, peer-signal review, and direct wallet-to-creator transfers.

children.title: [production] hermes-mine-bean
children.description: by MineBean - Autonomous $BEAN mining skill for the MineBean 5×5 grid protocol on Base. Supports zero-cost cron mode for unattended automation.

items.title: agentskills.io Ecosystem

children.title: [beta] hermes-web-search-plus
children.description: by robbyczgw-cla - Multi-provider web search with intelligent routing across Serper, Tavily, Exa, and more. Replaces the built-in search with better result quality and source diversity.

children.title: [production] DashClaw
children.description: by ucsandman - Approval and policy layer for agents: intercepts risky actions before they run and blocks or escalates them by rule. MIT.

children.title: [beta] rtk-hermes
children.description: by ogallotti - Plugin that intercepts shell commands via and rewrites output through RTK, compressing terminal output before it reaches the LLM context window. 60-90% token reduction on shell commands, 96.6% efficiency across 11M+ tokens processed. Zero config — auto-loads on gateway boot. Real benchmarks: 90-99%, 87%, 78%.

children.title: [beta] plur
children.description: by plur-ai - Shared memory layer for AI agents with open engram format (YAML). Useful for persistent learning patterns in Hermes workflows.

children.title: [beta] hermes-dynamic-workflows
children.description: by lingjiuu - Claude Code-style dynamic workflows for Hermes. Model writes sandboxed workflow scripts orchestrating subagents with , , and — up to 1000 subagents, persisted/resumable runs, live dashboard.

children.title: [beta] cronalytics
children.description: by 8bit64k - Cron cost and usage analytics. Hooks , stores analytics in local SQLite, surfaces via dashboard tab, CLI, and agent skill for cron health diagnostics. Multi-language (en, zh, zh-TW, es).

children.title: [beta] RoBrain
children.description: by adelinamart - Self-hosted decision memory plugin that records rejected alternatives and resurfaces their reasons when an agent revisits them. Uses Postgres and can run with a local model; Apache-2.0.

children.title: [experimental] hermes-cloudflare
children.description: by raulvidis - Cloudflare browser rendering plugin. Headless browsing through Cloudflare's infrastructure instead of local browser automation.

children.title: [beta] hermes-weather-plugin
children.description: by FahrenheitResearch - Professional-grade weather plugin with NWS model imagery, NEXRAD radar, and meteorological calculations.

children.title: [beta] hermes-curator-evolver
children.description: by pingchesu - Evidence-driven companion to v0.12's built-in Curator. Observes tool/skill/session events into local SQLite, backfills existing history, generates reports and dry-run proposals, supports optional Qwen embedding + bge reranking for candidate ordering, and runs a guarded daily autorun loop that only appends low-risk evidence-backed notes (with backups and rollback manifests). Inspired by SkillClaw but adapted to Hermes-native plugin hooks with explicit model opt-ins and pinned-skill safety.

children.title: [beta] eagle-eye
children.description: by willingning-coder - 5-layer intelligent skill routing engine. Narrows 50+ installed skills to top-5 candidates before each API call via Hard Triggers → FTS5 BM25 → Synonyms → Embeddings → RRF Fusion. Uses hook; confidence gate allows "no match" as a valid result.

children.title: [beta] agent-analytics-hermes-plugin
children.description: by Agent-Analytics - Native Signals dashboard tab for Hermes with read-only multi-project analytics, explicit timeframe, and theme-aware UI.

children.title: [beta] Hermes Live Voice

Keeps conversation responsive while durable Hermes runs execute in background, exposes bounded live progress, reports completion after reconnecting. Apple Silicon can run tested local HF speech-to-speech stack; Gemini Live and OpenAI Realtime also supported. v0.9.2, 733 tests, Docker/packed-install smokes, CodeQL and dependency review.

children.description: by BlockRunAI - Adds ClawRouter as a native model provider: 55+ LLMs from 9 providers through one local proxy, paid per-call in USDC via x402 instead of per-provider API keys, with a model picker, routing profiles, and usage stats. Thin Python adapter over the canonical TypeScript proxy; on PyPI. It manages a real wallet (BIP-39, Base + Solana) and recommends a pipe-to-shell installer — review before running and fund only what you'd spend. MIT.

children.title: [beta] hermes-live-discord-agent-plugin
children.description: by Capslockb - Full-duplex Discord voice bridge to Gemini Multimodal Live — 40+ function tools, vision, per-user memory, mid-conversation delegation, and transcripts. Pure NumPy codec plumbing with hard-clear barge-in.

items.title: Operational Playbooks

items.description: Opinionated bundles for teams that want to get more out of Hermes quickly without assembling the stack from scratch.

items.title: Operator cockpit for real work — Use hermes-workspace
items.description: for the richest daily UI, mission-control when you need multi-agent fleet visibility and cost tracking, and hermes-webui if you want a lighter ops surface.

items.title: Self-improvement without self-delusion — Pair hermes-agent-self-evolution
items.description: with scheduled regression checks, lintlang for prompt/config linting, and a second evaluation pass that blocks bad prompt mutations. The trick is not “evolve faster”; it’s “evolve without quietly getting weird.”

items.title: Paperclip-managed autonomous ops — For teams that want Hermes operating inside a governed company workflow, combine hermes-paperclip-adapter
items.description: with Hermes cron jobs and one of the operator dashboards above. That gives you task governance, approvals, and actual operational continuity instead of a clever demo that forgets what it was doing.

items.title: Memory stack that actually compounds — Start with built-in Hermes memory, then add honcho-self-hosted
items.description: when you want stronger cross-session user modeling, hindsight when you need retain/recall/reflect workflows across large histories, and plur when you want portable shared memory artifacts in an open engram format. If you also want proactive recall, pair it with flowstate-qmd.

items.title: Multi-agent execution layer — Combine Hermes core delegation with zouroboros-swarm-executors for local Claude Code/Hermes handoff, and opencode-hermes-multiagent
items.description: or bigiron when you need specialized agent roles.

items.title: Migration + deployment hardening — If you are moving from OpenClaw, keep openclaw-to-hermes
items.description: in the toolkit even if you prefer the native migration path. For repeatable deploys, look at nix-hermes-agent, hermes-agent-docker, and evey-setup depending on how opinionated you want the stack to be.
